description: Source-intent plus host semantic vectors; not evidence of compiler acceptance.

semantics.positionalIndex: zero-based current live dense row order, signed-wide checked before narrowing
semantics.rowHandle: private nominal owner/slot/generation token, never reconstructed from numeric fields
semantics.storage: one authoritative SoA column set, no hidden per-row AoS mirror
semantics.i64Encoding: signed 64-bit; JS BigInt; Wasm/CIL/native preserve exact semantics
semantics.schema: exact resolved nominal declaration identity, not spelling or physical fingerprint
semantics.insert: validate all fields and mint opaque handle before live-row publication; rollback on failure
semantics.swapDelete: surviving row handles retain identity and moved column data; deleted handles stale
semantics.loans: field read/read allowed; write excludes other loans to that field; any loan blocks structural change
semantics.compound: only compiler-proven synchronous primitive transaction; no getAt/setAt interleaving
semantics.reclamation: owner retire scrubs columns and revokes handles/loans; source borrowing cannot escape
semantics.actors: actor optional; owner may be ordinary function, Task scope or actor heap
semantics.unsupported: fail-closed; no implicit AoS projection, reflection, static fallbacks or unproved suspension

hostVectors.expected: -9223372036854775808 and 9223372036854775807 exact; reject overflow and JS Number conversion
store 0 or 1; reject invalid stored byte
erase_swap(first) moves tail to position 0; surviving tail handle resolves to 0
deleted/recycled slot increments generation; old handle remains stale
another owning array rejects handle even if slots/generations match
independent equal-geometry schemas cannot exchange field bindings
failure before handle issuance, or invalid row, leaves logical size and live columns unchanged
negative, -0 if explicitly forbidden, fractional, overflowing, spare capacity and NaN indices reject
read/read coexist, write excludes same-field loan and any loan excludes structural mutation
single non-suspending primitive transform; reject callback/racy split and unsupported integer semantics
close invalidates all handles and loans and clears physical payload
no mutable buffer crosses actor ownership boundary; snapshots are copies

promotionGates: exact-head compiler source positive and compile-negative with no generated artifacts on negative
actual generated guest execute and observable result, not host-only runtime tests
typed ownership and suspension escape negatives plus native memory bounds/sanitizers
Windows/Linux Native AOT for net; LLVM O0/O2 ASan/UBSan; Node and real browser for js; wasm32 runtime
approved private-source test environment and immutable binary/source provenance
independent review and merged/released code; do not upgrade drafts or zero-step CI
